1.1 A student must attend at least 80 percent of the lectures of each course to be allowed to sit the final examination. [academic-rules-2026.md / 1. Attendance]
The Head of Department may condone a further absence only for documented medical reasons. [academic-rules-2026.md / 1. Attendance]
1.2 A student who falls below the minimum attendance receives the grade FA in that course. [academic-rules-2026.md / 1. Attendance]
